faq_heading: Homes near Jessie Lee Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Jessie Lee Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Jessie Lee Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Jessie Lee Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Jessie Lee Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 198 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,287,500, townhomes $776,000, condos $530,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Jessie Lee Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Jessie Lee Elementary the median was 24 days on the market, closing at 97.0% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 198 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Jessie Lee Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Newbridge Academy (0.5 km south-west), White Rock Christian Academy (0.6 km north-west) and Star of the Sea (1.0 km north-west).

Jessie Lee Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 2064 154 St. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Late French Immersion.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Jessie Lee Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Jessie Lee Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Jessie Lee Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Jessie Lee Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 198 homes sold within 1 km of Jessie Lee Elementary: 36 houses, 27 townhomes and 121 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $530,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Jessie Lee Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Jessie Lee Elementary in a straight line (10 elementary, 3 other, 3 secondary; 5 independent). The closest is Newbridge Academy, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Morgan Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Star of the Sea (1.0 km); the nearest secondary school is Earl Marriott Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Earl Marriott Secondary (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Star of the Sea (1.0 km north-west), H T Thrift Elementary (1.4 km south-west), White Rock Elementary (1.7 km south), Peace Arch Elementary (1.8 km south-east), Sunnyside Elementary (1.8 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Star of the Sea, 1.0 km north-west of Jessie Lee Elementary.
